parsed.note_claim: Ronaldinho will not play competitive Serie C matches for Ravenna FC, only an exhibition game as part of a marketing and shareholder deal, per club vice-president Ariedo Braida.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Ronaldinho will do a marketing event with us, but he won't play for Ravenna in Serie C next season.
parsed.reason: The article directly quotes vice-president Ariedo Braida confirming Ronaldinho will not play competitive matches but will participate in a marketing event.
